description: US Congress bill status from the official GPO GovInfo BILLSTATUS bulk XML (the GovTrack API it replaces has closed): title, sponsor, introduced date, latest action and official congress.gov link for one bill by congress, bill type and number. Covers congresses with BILLSTATUS files (119 at test time). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

type.description: Bill type: hr, s, hres, sres, hjres, sjres, hconres or sconres

title: Gov Govtrack Congress
